title: The Wheel of Time (TV series)
production_companies: Amazon MGM StudiosCredited as Amazon Studios for seasons 1 and 2
premise_summary: The Wheel of Time is an American fantasy television series developed by Rafe Judkins for Amazon Prime Video. The series is based on the book series of the same name by Robert Jordan. It features an ensemble cast led by Rosamund Pike.
